# Shivam Goyal - Portfolio

> Shivam Goyal is a 2x Microsoft MVP (AI), Senior Analyst at EY Technology Consulting, and an Applied AI Engineer specializing in agentic systems, Azure AI, Microsoft Foundry, LLMOps, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). He designs production-ready enterprise AI solutions, multi-agent orchestration workflows, and AI platform engineering architectures.

This is the personal portfolio of Shivam Goyal. It covers his projects, technical articles and guides, Microsoft MVP activity (talks and community engagement), and endorsements. Canonical URLs end with a trailing slash. Older `.html` URLs redirect to the clean versions and should not be cited.

## About

- Role: Senior Analyst at Ernst & Young (EY), Technology Consulting; Applied AI Engineer
- Recognition: Microsoft MVP in Artificial Intelligence (2024, 2025)
- Education: The NorthCap University
- Expertise: agentic AI systems and multi-agent orchestration, Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI services, LLMOps and prompt optimization, RAG architectures, AI platform engineering and enterprise AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Semantic Kernel integrations, vector databases and semantic search
- Tools and frameworks: Microsoft Agent Framework, Foundry Local, Azure AI Agent Service, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Ollama, Python
